method.baseline.interval: An interval runs from the close of its first session to the close at the end shown; the first day's open-to-close is not included, unlike the monthly prior-close basis.
method.baseline.monthly: A full month runs from the previous month's last close to this month's last valid close; the current year and year-to-date progress are shown separately.
method.benchmark_rule: The stock's own N and the date-matched pair N are listed separately; a missing benchmark does not change the stock's N. Relative to benchmark is the simple per-sample return difference, not a risk-adjusted alpha.
method.drawdown_rule: Maximum drawdown follows the full daily-close path from the baseline to the end and is the positive loss from a peak to a later low; intraday paths are not included and it is not an achievable stop price.
method.empty: No sample meets the historical attribution, fact checks and complete price window at once; see the coverage gaps.
method.interpretation: Boxes and quantile bands describe these actual historical samples, not a forecast range; means, rankings, up counts or a single N threshold do not prove a tradable pattern.
method.leave_one_out.interpretation: Recomputed after dropping one year or event at a time; this checks the influence of single samples. It is not out-of-sample validation and adds no independent samples.
method.path_n_rule: N at each point of the path is the number of valid samples there and can differ from the full-window or paired N; the current year and incomplete windows are not mixed into the historical distribution.
method.price_basis: Price return, split-adjusted only; cash dividends not reinvested.
method.proportion.assumptions: Treated as independent binomial observations with a constant up probability and a sample fixed in advance; flat counts as not up. Correlation in financial samples, regime changes and after-the-fact selection can violate these assumptions.
method.proportion.interpretation: An interval for the historical share of up outcomes under these conditions, not a probability of a future rise or a return forecast.
method.scope.monthly: Each ticker compares 12 full historical months; ranking months, excluding years and trying windows repeatedly are exploratory, and the best month is not a reliable signal.
method.scope.other: Describes history within the chosen tickers, years and date/event windows; adjusting windows repeatedly or picking events afterwards causes selection bias, so fix the inclusion rules first.
method.segments.interpretation: Split at the midpoint of the target year span (all candidate years when no target is registered). The boundary is not chosen from returns or valid N after gaps; a descriptive comparison, not a significance or out-of-sample test.
method.warning.limited: Limited history; read means and proportions together with the actual points, sensitivity, gaps and how the study was chosen.
method.warning.overlap: Price windows overlap, so events are not independent repeated trials; the independence assumed by the Wilson interval does not hold.
method.warning.same_year: Several events fall in the same year; the event N is not the number of independent years.
method.warning.too_few: Too few valid samples to compare results with one sample removed; no stability is inferred.
